fields.v: Partly (0.5): mixed-effects models with 95% CIs and p-values per contrast and equal-weight per-problem robustness analyses, but a single run per problem-language-model (temperature 1.0), so run-to-run variability is not measured
fields.quote: To conserve tokens and budget, we instead randomly sample 100 tasks (yielding 2,000 sessions), and we refer to this subset as MiniLCB.
fields.why: Q8 asks for repetitions and statistical analysis; the statistics are strong but each configuration is run once (100 x 4 x 5 = 2,000), which the author's own value notes, so Yes vs Partly is a judgement call.
fields.doubt: Há análise estatística (modelos mistos, IC 95%), mas cada combinação problema-linguagem-modelo corre só uma vez (2.000 sessões = 100x4x5), com temperatura 1.0. Vê a pág. 3 e decide se Q8 fica Sim ou Parcial, de forma coerente com outros estudos sem repetições.
